Completed PCMRI Intaglio reproduction and conditional coarse-plus-six-scale tests. All nine formerly R/Matplotlib research figures on the current PCMRI dashboard now export through Intaglio as SVG/PDF/PNG; three existing native screenshots retained. Owned checkout /private/tmp/eyes4s-pcmri-viz-20261015, validation/pcmri-visuals-qualified, base bbb9d49a10a1fe7c1ff5f0acc1264aba61d961a9, Intaglio pin edcdfd5ffaf010e8205da04a85a7f8b6b2fd0d92. Test-scope adapter only, no library/API landing.
Validation passed: adapter compilation; nine SVG exports with embedded fonts, no text overlap/overflow; 76 estimates and their interval endpoints, 60 curve points, 62 stems, 19,488 raster cell colours, 17,928 PNG density samples; frozen inputs unchanged. No missing Intaglio capability prevented reproduction. Antialiased cell seams resolved with native RasterImage; no upstream issue needed for this adapter choice. Existing Studio visual defect mote remains open.
19,999 crossed participant/image bootstrap draws conditional on saved predictions; no refitting/selection within draws. Added six scales versus coarse-only behavior p: eyes4s participant .1464, crossed .3739; eyesim .1381/.4104. Crossed saliency .9840/.9608. All 24 prespecified-for-this-test-slice contrasts have p>.05; Holm-adjusted p=1. Exploratory conditional tests, not full tuning-pipeline inference.
Published owner-only permanent dashboard https://stellar-beacon-2sc6.here.now/ version 01M505R1J0DEHDZHPRK4X92M6G; 31 remote files hash-verified. Archived 94 files with hashes at fixtures/private/pcmri/runs/20261015-intaglio-prediction (gitignored): source adapter, frozen payload/input copies, all formats, checks and exact test definitions. G2 remains open: full application replication and timing provenance are not resolved by this slice.
